configuration: original Stork fixed4+1, no payload,4S3P P50B, BH2812V5 910KV10x6 two-blade
reserve_basis: 20 percent of nominal battery energy; planning policy
usable_energy_status: Sensitivity only until manufacturer discharge data/pack loss integration supports replacement. NOT statistical bounds or measured cold performance.
vtol_status: Planning sensitivities; not demonstrated selected4S lift-system consumption. Includes departure+transition+arrival allocation.
esc_efficiency_status: Explicit loss allowances; not measured Lumenier efficiency
voltage_status: Motor operating-point screens only; do not infer SOC, pack cutoff or full discharge energy from these voltages
auxiliary_status: Existing planning allowance, to be component-budgeted/calibrated
wind_model: Steady horizontal wind on straight one-way cruise leg. No gust or turnaround certification.
validity: Exclude insufficient lift, low aerodynamic confidence, out-of-map prop operating points and voltage/RPM/current infeasibility. Do not invent replacement values for failed solves.
